description: Generate or edit an image and return the resulting event stream. May end asking the user a question instead of producing an image; that is not a failure. Costs one credit per finished image.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Generated automatically. Supply the SAME one to retry safely.

input_asset_id.description: From dreamlayer_upload_image. Required for every operation except text_to_image.

operation.description: Name it to run deterministically and skip interpretation, so the request cannot come back as a question. Omit it to let DreamLayer read the prompt.

respond.description: Answer a previous question. Requires conversation_id.

name: dreamlayer_generate
